items.headline: Wind Advisory issued May 20 at 9:16PM AKDT until May 22 at 7:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 55 mph expected.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp.

* WHEN...From 1 PM Thursday to 7 AM AKDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects.
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.

items.headline: Flood Advisory issued May 20 at 9:15PM AKDT until May 22 at 12:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by high water due to snowmelt is expected.

* WHERE...Including the following area, Anvik.

* WHEN...Until midnight AKDT Thursday Night.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 912 PM AKDT, at Anvik, water levels continued to rise
Wednesday with low lying roads and a few structures being
inundated. When the ice jam at Russian Mission fails, water
levels should lower in Anvik as the backwater flows
downriver.

items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued May 20 at 2:42PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
ESFAFG

...Locations Impacted...
Yukon Delta

As of noon Wednesday, an Ice Jam near Russian Mission has caused
water to back up from Russian Mission to Anvik. When the ice jam
eventually releases this water will flow towards the Yukon Delta.
Most large Yukon River ice jams during recent years decay, erode and
